dashboard.browseProgram: Primary call-to-action button in the hero. Rendered uppercase with wide letter-spacing by CSS, so keep it to roughly 2 words / 18 characters or it wraps.
dashboard.continue: Primary button on the add-to-homescreen prompt when no install prompt is available — it just proceeds into the app. Rendered uppercase.
dashboard.dateRangeUnavailable: Sentence fragment shown in the hero where the event's start-to-end dates would normally sit, when those dates are missing.
dashboard.directory: Section heading above the four navigation cards. Rendered uppercase by CSS; one short word.
dashboard.directoryCrew: Navigation card title — the people running the event (staff/volunteers), not the attendees. Keep short; sits in a half-width card.
dashboard.directoryEventGuidance: Navigation card title (links to the event guidance page). Its subtitle comes from tenant content and is translated separately. Two lines max in a half-width card.
dashboard.directoryOrganisations: Navigation card title (links to the list of participating organisations). Keep short; sits in a half-width card.
dashboard.directoryVenues: Navigation card title (links to venue info and the site map). The slash joins two nouns; keep short, half-width card.
dashboard.enterSummit: Button on the final onboarding slide that leaves onboarding and opens the app. "Enter" as in go in. Rendered uppercase with wide letter-spacing; keep under ~16 characters.
dashboard.installAndContinue: Primary button on the add-to-homescreen prompt on Android, where tapping triggers the browser's install dialog before proceeding. Rendered uppercase with wide letter-spacing; keep under ~24 characters.
dashboard.locationUnavailable: Sentence fragment shown in the hero where the event's location would normally sit, when it is missing.
dashboard.next: Button advancing to the next onboarding slide. Rendered uppercase; keep to one short word.
dashboard.onboardingSlideCounter: Progress indicator at the top of the onboarding carousel. {current} is the 1-based slide number, {total} the count of slides. Rendered uppercase at 11px; keep short.
dashboard.programEmptyBody: Empty-state sentence under dashboard.programEmptyTitle. Full sentence, keep the final full stop.
dashboard.programEmptyTitle: Empty-state heading shown before any sessions are scheduled. "Program" = the schedule of sessions.
dashboard.programEndedBody: Empty-state body shown after the last session has finished. Two full sentences; "wrapped" means finished/concluded.
dashboard.programEndedTitle: Empty-state heading shown after the last session has finished. Warm and addressed to the delegate; no full stop in the original.
dashboard.skip: Button that dismisses the onboarding carousel and the add-to-homescreen prompt without finishing them. Used in both overlays. Rendered uppercase in a narrow one-third-width button, so it must stay very short (~8 characters).
dashboard.startsAt: Session start time on a speaker card. {time} is a 24-hour clock value such as "09:30", already in the event's own timezone. Rendered uppercase at 10px; keep the lead-in to one or two words.
dashboard.summitFallbackName: Stand-in for the event's name, and the small overline shown above the event title in the hero when the name has no subtitle part. "Summit" here means the gathering/conference itself. Rendered uppercase in the overline; keep to one word.
dashboard.summitFallbackTitle: Large hero heading, used only when no event name is available at all. "Dashboard" = the app's home screen.
dashboard.timeToBeConfirmed: Shown in place of the start time on a speaker card when the session has no scheduled time yet. Rendered uppercase at 10px.
dashboard.upNext: Section heading above the list of sessions starting soon. Rendered uppercase by CSS; keep very short.
dashboard.viewFullLineup: Small link beside the "Up Next" heading, going to the full speaker list. Rendered uppercase at 10px, so it must stay short (~16 characters).
detail.backTo: Back-link label above a detail page; rendered with .toUpperCase() in the JSX, so keep it short and make sure it reads well in caps. {domain} is the plural domain noun (Speakers, Venues, ...), supplied already translated from the detail.domain* keys.
detail.bioHeading: Section heading above a person's biography; used only as the fallback when a domain does not supply its own heading. One or two words.
detail.contactOnWhatsapp: Button label on a crew member's page (opens wa.me); rendered uppercase with wide letter-spacing, so keep it short. "WhatsApp" is a product name and must not be translated.
detail.detailsHeading: Section heading above the field list (label/value pairs) on a detail page. One or two words.
detail.domainAttractions: Plural name of the attractions (things to see and do) section; only used inside detail.backTo, and uppercased there.
detail.domainCrew: Name of the crew (event staff/volunteers) section; only used inside detail.backTo, and uppercased there.
detail.domainEvents: Plural name of the events section; only used inside detail.backTo, and uppercased there.
detail.domainOrganisations: Plural name of the organisations section; only used inside detail.backTo, and uppercased there. Australian English spelling in the source.
detail.domainSpeakers: Plural name of the speakers section; only used inside detail.backTo, and uppercased there. Translate as the plural noun, not a sentence.
detail.domainSponsors: Plural name of the sponsors section; only used inside detail.backTo, and uppercased there.
detail.domainVenues: Plural name of the venues section; only used inside detail.backTo, and uppercased there.
detail.summaryHeading: Section heading above a short summary paragraph. One or two words.
detail.videoHeading: Section heading above an embedded video player. One word.
lists.allRoles: Label on the first role filter chip — the one that clears the filter. Very tight space: chip is half the screen width, ~2 lines of 12px text.
lists.allRolesEyebrow: Tiny 9px uppercase eyebrow above 'All roles' on the clear-filter chip. One short word; do not translate as a sentence.
lists.crewRolesTablist: aria-label on the role filter tab list. Screen-reader only, never visible.
lists.crewTitle: Page H1 on the crew list page (large display type). Same English word as lists.allRolesEyebrow but a page title, so it may translate differently.
lists.emptyBody: Empty-state sentence under lists.emptyTitle. {label} is the lowercased plural domain name; {summit} is the summit's name.
lists.emptyCrewRoleBody: Empty-state sentence under lists.emptyCrewRoleTitle. {role} is the role name as shown on the filter chip.
lists.emptyCrewRoleTitle: Empty-state heading when a role filter is active but matches no crew.
lists.emptyCrewTitle: Empty-state heading when the summit has no crew records at all.
lists.emptyTitle: Empty-state heading on a list page. {label} is the lowercased plural domain name (speakers, venues, events, organisations, sponsors, attractions, crew).
lists.filterByRole: Small uppercase heading above the crew role filter chips. Keep short (renders in a single narrow line, letter-spaced uppercase).
lists.loadMoreOrganisations: Button label under the paginated organisations grid, rendered uppercase with wide letter-spacing beside a download icon. Keep short — long strings wrap awkwardly.
lists.roleEyebrow: Tiny 9px uppercase eyebrow above each individual role name on a filter chip. One short word.
lists.showingCount: 11px caption under the Load more button. {shown} and {total} are numbers.
moments.backToGallery: Link label in moderation mode; rendered in ALL CAPS by the code (.toUpperCase()), so supply natural sentence case here. Keep short — it sits next to a back arrow on one line.
moments.cancel: Dialog button, dismisses the delete confirmation. Keep short.
moments.close: Button that dismisses the upload-terms dialog. Keep short.
moments.columnCount: aria-label on each column-count button ({count} is 1, 2 or 3). Screen-reader only; the button itself just shows the digit.
moments.columns: Label for the 1/2/3-column grid switcher above the photo wall. Displayed in ALL CAPS by CSS — supply natural case. Very tight space, one word.
moments.dayHeading: Section heading grouping photos by summit day. {day} is 1, 2 or 3.
moments.delete: Dialog button, confirms the destructive delete. Keep short.
moments.deleteConfirmTitleMany: Confirmation dialog heading for 0 or 2+ items. {count} is a number. Paired with moments.deleteConfirmTitleOne — translators needing more plural forms should flag it, the code only branches one/many.
moments.deleteConfirmTitleOne: Confirmation dialog heading, singular case (exactly one item selected). Paired with moments.deleteConfirmTitleMany.
moments.deleteFailed: Browser alert() text after a failed bulk delete in moderation mode. {count} is a number; the English keeps the "(s)" form rather than branching on plural.
moments.deleteSelected: Button label in moderation mode. {count} is how many items are ticked. Keep short — full-width button on mobile.
moments.loadError: Error banner shown when the photo wall fails to load. Full sentence. Uses a typographic apostrophe (’).
moments.loadMoreError: Error banner when infinite-scroll paging fails. Typographic apostrophe (’).
moments.loadingMore: aria-label on the loading spinner while the next page of photos loads. Screen-reader only, never displayed.
moments.loadingPhotos: Placeholder under a spinner while the gallery loads. Uses a single ellipsis character (…).
moments.missingFile: Small badge on a broken photo tile, moderation mode only. Displayed in ALL CAPS by CSS (uppercase class) — supply natural case. Very tight space, 2 words max.
moments.noPhotosBody: Empty-album body copy on desktop (no camera capture).
moments.noPhotosBodyMobile: Empty-album body copy on mobile. "the card above" refers to the upload card on screen.
moments.noPhotosTitle: Heading of the empty album state, under a picture emoji. Keep short.
moments.nothingSelected: Same empty state on desktop, where camera capture is not offered.
moments.nothingSelectedMobile: Empty-state sentence shown on mobile (where camera capture is available). Two sentences.
moments.pageTitle: Page h1 for the shared photo gallery. The album of photos delegates share. One short word.
moments.retry: Button (text link) under the error banner. Keep very short.
moments.select: Visible label beside the moderation checkbox on each tile. Very tight space — one short word.
moments.selectPhoto: aria-label on a photo's selection checkbox in moderation mode. {filename} is the uploaded file's name; not displayed visually.
moments.showingCount: Tiny caption under the photo wall. {shown} = photos loaded so far, {total} = total available. Both are numbers.
moments.showreelEmpty: Empty state in the showreel carousel. Full sentence.
moments.termsAgree: Small print under the upload control. {terms} is replaced by a clickable link whose text is moments.termsLink — keep the placeholder, and move it wherever the grammar needs it.
moments.termsAssignment: First paragraph of the legal upload terms. {entity} is the tenant's legal entity name (rendered in bold, not translated) — keep the placeholder and place it as the grammar requires. Legal text: translate conservatively.
moments.termsLink: The link text substituted into moments.termsAgree; opens the upload-terms dialog. Lower-case mid-sentence in English. One or two words.
moments.termsTitle: Heading of the upload-terms dialog. Contains an em dash (—).
moments.termsUse: Second paragraph of the upload terms. {entity} is the tenant's legal entity name, untranslated. Legal text.
moments.termsWarranty: Third paragraph of the upload terms. Legal text.
nav.channelLinkComingSoon: Fallback one-line subtitle under a channel name when no link has been configured yet. Truncates — keep short.
nav.channelOpenInWhatsapp: Fallback one-line subtitle under a channel name when the channel has a link but no members/description text from the data. Truncates — keep short.
nav.drawerMenuLabel: aria-label on the slide-in drawer when it shows the navigation menu (screen readers only).
nav.drawerWhatsappLabel: aria-label on the same slide-in drawer when it shows the WhatsApp channel list (screen readers only).
nav.joinWhatsappCommunity: Prominent link button at the top of the WhatsApp drawer; opens the community invite. Truncates on narrow phones, so keep it short.
nav.menuClose: Same header button once the drawer is open. Same fixed 78px width and CSS uppercasing — keep to roughly 6 characters.
nav.menuOpen: Header button label that opens the full-screen menu drawer. Rendered in a fixed 78px-wide button and CSS-uppercased, so keep it to roughly 6 characters.
nav.viewFullMenu: Small link opening the slide-out menu. Rendered uppercase at 10px — keep under ~16 characters.
nav.whatsappChannelsEmpty: Empty-state sentence shown in place of the channel list when the tenant has no channels. Full sentence, keep the full stop.
nav.whatsappChannelsHeading: Section heading above the channel list. CSS-uppercased and letter-spaced on one line — keep it short.
nav.whatsappClose: aria-label on the same icon button while the WhatsApp panel is open (screen readers only). "WhatsApp" is a product name — do not translate it.
nav.whatsappOpen: aria-label on the round WhatsApp icon button in the header (screen readers only, no length limit). "WhatsApp" is a product name — do not translate it.
pages.backToHome: Button label at the foot of the Acknowledgement of Country page. Rendered uppercase with wide letter-spacing by CSS, so give natural case here; keep to about 3 words.
pages.codeConductContactWellbeing: Primary button label linking to the crew list filtered to wellbeing coordinators. Rendered uppercase with wide letter-spacing by CSS, so give natural case here and keep it reasonably short — long translations wrap to two lines on narrow phones.
pages.codeConductPdfLink: Full-width button label that opens the printable PDF of the code of conduct. NOTE: the English source contains a typo ("pintable" should be "printable"); preserved verbatim during extraction — translate as "printable".
pages.codeConductReportBody: Body sentence in the reporting card at the foot of the Code of Conduct page, directly above the contact button.
pages.codeConductTitle: Large page title on the Code of Conduct page. Also reused as the heading for a bullet section in the authored content that has no heading of its own, so it must work as both a page title and a section heading.
pages.codeConductUnavailableTitle: Empty-state heading shown when no code-of-conduct content exists for this summit.
pages.surveyFallbackName: Fallback name for a survey with no Name field. Used as the card title, the page heading, and the embedded iframe's accessible title, so it must read as a plain noun. Keep very short.
pages.surveyMissingUrl: Message shown in place of the embedded survey when the survey record has no URL.
pages.surveysEmptyTitle: Empty-state heading when the summit has no surveys configured.
pages.surveysTitle: Large page title on the surveys list page.
pages.venueFallbackName: Fallback name shown on a venue card when the venue record has no Name. Single noun, keep very short.
pages.venueLocatedAt: Fallback one-sentence venue summary used only when the venue has no description. {address} is the street address. A full stop is appended automatically if the translation does not already end in . ! or ?
pages.venuesHeading: Card heading on the Event Guidance page, above the venue grid. Rendered uppercase by CSS, so give natural case here. Keep short (one or two words).
pages.viewVenuePage: Small call-to-action label at the bottom of a venue card. Rendered uppercase by CSS at 10px, so keep it to about 3 words or it wraps.
photo.cancel: The dismiss button in the delete-confirmation dialog, sitting left of the Delete button. One short word, roughly 10 characters max so the two buttons stay on one row.
photo.closeViewer: aria-label on the X button that closes the lightbox. Appears on two separate buttons (the mobile toolbar one and the desktop top-left one) that are never shown at the same time. Screen-reader only, never visible, no length limit.
photo.delete: Two places, both moderation-only: the hover tooltip (title) and aria-label on the trash icon in the lightbox toolbar, AND the visible confirm button in the delete dialog. Must work as both a button label and a tooltip — one short word, roughly 10 characters max so the dialog button does not wrap.
photo.deleteConfirmBody: Body text directly under photo.deleteConfirmTitle in the delete-confirmation dialog, 14px muted, in a card about 24rem wide (2-3 lines). Two sentences — keep both full stops.
photo.deleteConfirmTitle: h2 heading of the moderation delete-confirmation dialog, 18px semibold. Moderator-facing, not seen by ordinary delegates. Keep it a short one-line question; "item" covers both photos and videos.
photo.deleteFailed: Native browser alert() shown when a delete fails for any reason other than 401. Moderator-facing only. Plain text in an OS dialog, no markup. Note the English uses a curly apostrophe (U+2019).
photo.deleting: Replaces photo.delete on the confirm button while the delete request is in flight (button is disabled). Renders in the same button as photo.delete, so keep a similar width. Keep the single-character ellipsis (…).
photo.download: Hover tooltip (title) and aria-label on the down-arrow icon button in the lightbox toolbar; saves the file to the device. One short word.
photo.loadingImage: sr-only text beside the spinner while a lightbox image is still loading. Screen-reader only, never visible, no length limit. Keep the single-character ellipsis (…).
photo.moderationSessionExpired: Native browser alert() shown when a delete returns HTTP 401. Moderator-facing only, never seen by delegates. Plain text in an OS dialog — no length limit, no markup, but keep it to two short sentences.
photo.next: aria-label on the right chevron arrow button in the lightbox (sm and wider only). Screen-reader only, never visible, no length limit.
photo.openFullSize: Hover tooltip (title) and aria-label on the arrow-out-of-box icon button in the lightbox toolbar; opens the original file in a new browser tab. Tooltip is visible on desktop hover, so keep it to a short phrase.
photo.previous: aria-label on the left chevron arrow button in the lightbox (shown at sm and wider only). Screen-reader only, never visible, no length limit.
photo.resetZoom: Hover tooltip (title) and aria-label on the small pill button that shows the current zoom percentage and resets it to 100%. Only appears while zoomed in. Keep to one or two short words.
photo.share: Hover tooltip (title) and aria-label on the share icon button in the lightbox toolbar (uses the native OS share sheet, falls back to copying the link). One short word.
photo.showActions: aria-label on the invisible full-bleed button laid over a VIDEO in the lightbox on mobile; reveals the action buttons. Screen-reader only, never visible, no length limit.
photo.takePhoto: Visible label on the left of the two capture buttons on the Moments upload card; opens the phone's rear camera. Delegate-facing. The button is flex-1, so on a phone it is half the card width — about 14 characters before it wraps to a second line. Sits to the right of a camera icon. English is Title Case in the current UI; I preserved it verbatim rather than change what delegates see, but sentence case ("Take a photo") is fine for translations and for English if you want to normalise it.
photo.takeVideo: Visible label on the right of the two capture buttons on the Moments upload card; opens the phone's video camera. Same flex-1 half-width button, ~14 characters, preceded by a video-camera icon. Keep it parallel in structure to photo.takePhoto. English is Title Case verbatim from the existing UI.
photo.toggleActions: aria-label on the tappable image area in the lightbox, mobile only (<640px). Tapping reveals/hides the floating action buttons. Screen-reader only, never visible, no length limit.
photo.viewItem: aria-label on each thumbnail in the filmstrip under the lightbox (desktop only). {number} is the 1-based position of that photo or video in the album. Screen-reader only, never visible, no length limit. "item" covers both photos and videos.
photo.zoomIn: Hover tooltip (title) and aria-label on the magnifier-plus icon button in the lightbox toolbar. Keep to one or two short words.
photo.zoomLevel: The visible label inside that reset-zoom pill, e.g. "150%". {percent} is a whole number from 100 to 400. Extremely tight: 11px semibold text in a pill about 4 characters wide. Adjust only the spacing/placement of the percent sign for your locale (e.g. French "150 %") — never add words.
photo.zoomOut: Used twice on the same magnifier-minus icon button in the lightbox toolbar: as the hover tooltip (title, visible on desktop) and as the aria-label. Keep to one or two short words.
program.badgeSpeaker: Tiny badge on a talk card, rendered in CSS uppercase. One word; must fit a 9px pill.
program.dayNumber: Fallback label for a day tab when the data has no name/title, e.g. "Day 1". {number} is the 1-based day number.
program.dayPending: Empty-state sentence shown inside a day tab that has no sessions yet.
program.daysTablistLabel: aria-label on the row of day tabs; screen-reader only, never visible.
program.emptyBody: Empty-state body sentence directly under program.emptyTitle.
program.emptyTitle: Empty-state heading shown when no schedule days exist. Short.
program.eventSession: Placeholder name shown (and used as the avatar image alt text) on a non-talk card when no speaker is named. Two or three words.
program.formatEvent: Fallback session-format badge for a non-talk session when the data supplies no format label. Rendered uppercased in a tiny pill; one short word.
program.formatTalk: Fallback session-format badge for a talk when the data supplies no format label. Rendered uppercased in a tiny pill; one short word.
program.pageTitle: Page h1 heading for the schedule page. One or two words; renders large.
program.presentedBy: Names the person leading a session, on the programme card and the dashboard's Up Next card. {name} is a personal name and is never translated. Sits under a session title in a narrow card, so keep the framing to one or two words.
program.sessionSpeaker: Placeholder name shown (and used as the avatar image alt text) on a talk card when no speaker is named. Two or three words.
program.timesSubjectToChange: Small footnote under the timeline, next to a map-pin icon. Keep short.
program.viewDetails: Link text on every session card, followed by a chevron icon. Very tight space — keep to two short words if possible.
share.backToApp: Link at the top-left of the "Share a moment" upload card, next to a back arrow. Rendered as {t("share.backToApp").toUpperCase()} so it keeps the original all-caps look; store natural case here. One line at 12px — keep to roughly 12 characters.
share.continue: Submit button on the moderation password form. Short button label.
share.dropzoneTap: Label inside the upload dropzone on mobile. Keep to one short line.
share.intro: Lead paragraph of the upload card, directly under the back link. Two to three lines on a phone; no hard limit.
share.moderationPrompt: Sentence under the "Protected" heading explaining the password box. "Moments" is the name of the shared photo gallery feature in this app — keep it as a name.
share.moderationTitle: Heading of the password gate shown in place of the Moments gallery for moderators. One word on one line — keep short.
share.passwordHide: aria-label on the same eye toggle while the password is visible (screen readers only, no length limit).
share.passwordLabel: Used twice for the same field on the moderation login: the sr-only <label> and the input's placeholder. One word — must fit inside the input, so keep short.
share.passwordShow: aria-label on the eye toggle beside the moderation password field while the password is masked (screen readers only, no length limit).
share.scrollToTop: aria-label on the floating round scroll-to-top button that appears after 400px of scrolling in the Moments gallery. Icon-only button, so this is the only name a screen reader gets. No length limit.
share.selectedCount: Pill badge on the upload card showing how many files are queued. CSS-uppercased and letter-spaced inside a small rounded pill — keep it very short (roughly 12 characters plus the number).
share.signInFailed: Red role="alert" line above the submit button when the server rejects the password without giving its own message. One short line.
share.signInNetworkError: Red role="alert" line above the submit button when the sign-in request never reaches the server. One short line.
share.signingIn: Label of the moderation login submit button while the request is in flight. Replaces share.continue in the same button — keep to a similar width.
share.upload: Primary upload button label when no file count is shown. Full-width button — keep short.
share.uploadComplete: Announced through the sr-only aria-live region when a client-side (blob) upload session finishes. Never visible on screen; no length limit.
share.uploadCount: Primary upload button label with the number of queued files, e.g. "Upload (3)". Was built by string concatenation in the source; now one key so word order can change. Full-width button — keep short.
share.uploadFailed: Fallback error text when the server or the blob SDK gives no message of its own. Appears in the red error list on the upload card, and as the {message} half of share.uploadFileError. Keep short — it is often prefixed by a filename.
share.uploadFileError: One row of the red error list when a single file fails during a multi-file upload. {filename} is the raw device filename (untranslated); {message} is the failure reason, usually share.uploadFailed or text from the server. Was a template literal in the source; kept as one key so the separator and order can change per language.
share.uploadPercent: Progress readout under the spinner in the full-screen upload overlay. {percent} is a whole number 0-100. Was a bare "%" glued to a JSX expression; here as one key so locales that space the sign differently can do so.
share.uploadProgress: aria-label on the full-screen progressbar overlay shown during upload (screen readers only, no length limit).
share.uploadSection: aria-label on the <section> holding the camera, dropzone and preview list (screen readers only, no length limit).
share.uploadStarted: Announced through the sr-only aria-live region when the delegate taps Upload. Never visible on screen; no length limit.
share.uploadSuccess: Green role="status" confirmation line under the upload controls after a successful upload. One short sentence.
share.uploadUnexpectedError: Catch-all error in the red error list when the upload throws (network drop, aborted session). Two short sentences; the box wraps freely.
share.uploading: Shown in two places while an upload runs: the centred text of the full-screen progress overlay, and the primary button label. The source had "Uploading…" in one and "Uploading..." in the other; harmonised to a single key with a typographic ellipsis. Keep short — it shares the button with a spinner.
share.venueMapsHint: Instruction line under the Venue Maps heading, above the thumbnail grid. Covers both touch and pointer, hence "Tap or click". One sentence.
share.venueMapsTitle: Heading above the venue map thumbnails on the venue page. Title case in the design; one line — keep short.
share.videoMax: Small grey note under the intro paragraph on the upload card. The 250 MB figure is a fixed server limit, not a variable — keep the number and unit as written.
